name: agent_takes_a_task
title: Tasks · a task given to an agent in words is done by its run, with its steps

steps.say: keep a list of deals: the firm's name, the asking price and the yearly revenue
steps.reply:
I've set up a **Deal list** in a new Deals module. It has three fields: firm name, asking price and yearly revenue. There are no deals in it yet.

I assumed the prices are in dollars. If you use another currency, tell me and I'll change it.

Tell me the first deal, for example "Acme Co, asking 2M, revenue 800k", and I'll add it. You can also give me several at once.

I added **Midwest HVAC** to your deal list, with an asking price of $900,000 and yearly revenue of $1,200,000. I assumed the amounts are in dollars.

The asking price is 0.75× yearly revenue. Revenue isn't profit, so I can't say whether that's cheap until I know the firm's earnings.

steps.say: add a task on Midwest HVAC to work out the asking price as a multiple of revenue, give it to the Deal Analyst and start it
steps.reply:
I added the task "Work out Midwest HVAC's asking price as a multiple of its yearly revenue". It sits on the Midwest HVAC row in your Deal list and is assigned to the Deal Analyst. I started it, and the Deal Analyst should pick it up within about half a minute. Its runs will show on the task's page.

From the numbers you gave me, I expect the answer to be 0.75×: $900,000 asking against $1,200,000 revenue.
